name: @lockstep/indexer
//: envio is a runtime dependency, not a dev one, and the distinction is a deployment requirement
rather than a preference: Envio Cloud requires the envio version to be declared in
`dependencies` in the indexer's root folder, and refuses the deployment otherwise. It was in
devDependencies, which is defensible locally -- the CLI is a build tool -- and would have
Deliberately NOT a member of the root npm workspace. Envio Cloud installs with pnpm from the
root directory configured for the indexer, so this package has to resolve on its own. Being a
workspace member would put its dependency tree in the repository root, where the hosted build
would not look for it. That is also why src/EventHandlers.ts imports nothing outside this
directory, which Envio's monorepo guidance requires.
